item.text: {"review":"Trace ordinary success and failure, repeated operations, deferred work, cancellation, and relevant event orderings. At each lifecycle boundary, record the prior state, return value, resulting state, object identity, and observable effects. Check whether different histories produce the same result while implying different effects, and distinguish scheduling or cancellation from the start and completion of work. Compare contract language with implementation evidence, checking exclusions, configuration and version limits, and whether a guarantee applies only to a narrower set of conditions. Follow delegated behavior to its implementation when available, and distinguish internal representation from what callers can observe. Cite the source that supports each material claim, retain correct controls, and mark unresolved intent, apparent contradictions, or gaps in source evidence as OPEN questions."}
